dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Let the wind lead, Honorary Knight. As you can see, the Knights are currently piloting Wargaming simulations. If you can spare the time, we hope you can assist us in completing the testing.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: I'm Phonia, intelligence officer of the reorganized 7th Company, and also one of the people who proposed this Wargame.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Currently, my main tasks are the development and maintenance of alchemical recon equipment, collecting intel, and analyzing enemies. If you need help, just contact my acting superior.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Well, we all work for the Knights of Favonius, and we're all on the clock right now, so rather than indulging ourselves in exchanges of meaningless information, our time would be best used discussing useful intel...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: I am but an ordinary cog in the machine that is the Knights of Favonius. Aside from my duties, any information about me is of no significance to you.

choices.text: Well, "cog" is a rather peculiar way to describe yourself.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: It is only the truth. I'm just an ordinary person without any particular talent or ambition. I'm just here to do what I can.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: And that's fine by me. I worry about nothing outside of my duties, and I live an ordinary life. A good way to avoid troubles, really.

choices.text: Err, could you tell me a bit about yourself anyway?

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: I've told you all that's worth hearing. Or would you like to hear something more personal? Let me think...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: I'm Phonia, 26 years old, single. I currently live in the third room on the third floor of the third building to the right of the city gates. I have a roommate called Ematol, who also happens to be my tenant, and the monthly rent is... I forget, it's not important.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: My hobby is sleeping. After work, I just go home and sleep. If it's too noisy, I'll have some wine to help me sleep. I don't remember what kind of wine I used to drink, but that's not important either. As long as it can get me drunk, it's good wine.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: As for where I was born, how I spent my childhood, what my parents did before I was born, and all that, I suspect such things are far less significant.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: If you don't need any more information from me, please allow me to continue my analysis work. Of course, if you do have any questions about the Wargame, please feel free to consult me at any time.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Yes. 7th Company was only reorganized recently, so we haven't yet settled on our captaincy.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: The 7th Company is temporarily designated as a "Combined Arms Company," which integrates knights with a range of capabilities into a single combat unit, with a balance of ranged and melee firepower. Such a unit is also very reliant on reconnaissance.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: In time, the expeditionary force's No. 2 — the venerable Commander Frederica Gunnhildr — might become our Company's Captain.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: After all, Commander Frederica has served for longer than many Knights have been alive, and her experience in battle is unmatched. It wouldn't be too much to say she is perfectly suited for leadership.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Correct! Commander Frederica is the Acting Grand Master's mother, and is renowned throughout Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: She's been on active duty on the front lines for decades now, never tiring or slowing. When the youths of Mondstadt talk of their dreams of being a hero, the name "Frederica" is never far from their lips.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: And I was one of them! When I joined the Knights of Favonius, it was because of my admiration for Commander Frederica...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Of course, I later realized that I was only talented enough to be just one more cog in the machine. As for the heroic protagonists of the storybooks that can take on a hundred foes all alone... that's another story.

response.speaker: Traveler
response.text: So Jean's mother... will be your captain?

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: That's only my speculation as an intelligence officer. As I see it, the 7th Company will likely be one of the most formidable units, and so Commander Frederica would be the most suitable candidate for Captain.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Though Commander Frederica's position in the Knights of Favonius has long surpassed any ordinary Captain, she's never been one for pushing pencils. She's always insisted on staying on the front lines, toe-to-toe with foes.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: In principle, the Knights of Favonius value ability and experience equally, so after she returns, perhaps we'll see the Acting Grand Master giving orders to Commander Frederica...

choices.text: Isn't that also Jean's last name...?

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Yes. As I'm sure you've seen, the scourge of monsters wandering the wilds remains one of the issues that all nations in Teyvat must deal with.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: In short, I've drawn inspiration from the Millelith General Staff's previous methods, collating all manner of reports in order to construct this Wargame.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: By simulating battles between monsters, we can learn the best strategies to defeat them while in a non-combat environment. If you're interested, please give it a try yourself.

response.speaker: Traveler
response.text: It looks like... a game of chess?

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: You're certainly right about that. There are indeed similarities between the conduct of Wargames and chess, so the comparison is quite apt.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: "Playing chess" is enough to help conduct valuable tactical analysis, and that's also where the charm of Wargames lie. You can just think of it as a regular "chess game."

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: In any case, I've applied for permission from the Acting Grand Master. Everyone is free to take part in these simulations, and all participants will be entitled to a thank-you gift.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: So if you have the time, Honorary Knight, I hope that you, too, will take part in our simulations. After all, I doubt that there are many in Mondstadt who know more about monsters than you do.

choices.text: I see. I'll give it a go when I have time, then.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: My thanks. We've already prepared the board, so we can begin at any time. I look forward to witnessing a commanding performance from you, Honorary Knight.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: The battlefield brims with uncertainty. No matter how thorough the investigation, the fog of war, which no wind can disperse, will still shroud about three-quarters of it.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: As such, the more participants we get, the more likely we can simulate even the most unpredictable of monster behavior patterns.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: All strategy and theory can only be based on real tactical results. No matter what the battle situation, only the success of our strategies can determine victory or defeat.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Such simulations help to expose our weaknesses, such that we Knights can improve them in real future combat scenarios.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: It's alright. Analyzing the simulation results is an intelligence officer's duty, Honorary Knight. You, as the commander, do not have to fret over these details. Just focus on doing battle.

choices.text: Got it. So I'll play the chess, and you'll do the rest?

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Precisely. Analyzing the simulation results is an intelligence officer's duty, Honorary Knight. You, as the commander, do not have to fret over these details — simply command.

choices.text: Well, I'll leave you to it then. See you.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Alright. You stay safe as well.
